name: OrderTracker
description:
A shipment card: the order number and total, a status badge, the delivery progress, a timeline of steps and the courier - composed from Badge, Progress, Icon, Separator, Avatar and Button.

  OrderTracker(number: "10482", items: 2, total: 148, status: :in_transit, progress: 75) do
    OrderTimeline do
      OrderStep(title: :confirmed, at: order.confirmed_at, state: :done)
      OrderStep(title: :out_for_delivery, at: Time.current, state: :current)
      OrderStep(title: :delivered, at: order.eta, state: :upcoming)
    end
    OrderCourier(name: "Marcus", avatar: courier.avatar_url, stops: 3, href: tracking_url)
  end

Localized (order_tracker.locales.yml): statuses, step titles given as symbols, item and stop counts (pluralized), money and times ("Today, 11:05 AM", "ETA 2:15 PM").
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `OrderTracker(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

OrderCourier.description: The courier row under a separator: avatar, "Marcus is on the way", stops left and a button to the live map.

OrderStep.description: One step: :done (a check), :current (a ringed dot) or :upcoming (a hollow dot, its time shown as an ETA). `title:` may be a translation key (:confirmed, :shipped, :sorting_hub, :local_facility, :out_for_delivery, :delivered) or any string; `at:` a Time.

OrderTimeline.description: The list of shipment steps, joined by a line.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: The Appica homepage card - the order is out for delivery today.
examples.code:
today = Time.current.beginning_of_day

phlex do
  OrderTracker(number: "10482", items: 2, total: 148, status:, progress: progress.to_f, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    OrderTimeline do
      OrderStep(title: :confirmed, at: today - 2.days + 9.hours + 41.minutes)
      OrderStep(title: :shipped, at: today - 1.day + 18.hours + 12.minutes)
      OrderStep(title: :sorting_hub, at: today + 7.hours + 48.minutes)
      OrderStep(title: :local_facility, at: today + 8.hours + 30.minutes)
      OrderStep(title: :out_for_delivery, at: today + 11.hours + 5.minutes, state: :current)
      OrderStep(title: :delivered, at: today + 14.hours + 15.minutes, state: :upcoming)
    end
    OrderCourier(name: "Marcus", avatar: "/avatars/02.png", stops: 3, href: "#map")
  end
end

examples.name: Delivered
examples.notes: All steps done, the courier row dropped.
examples.code:
today = Time.current.beginning_of_day

phlex do
  OrderTracker(number: "10377", items: 1, total: 59.9, currency: "EUR", status: :delivered, progress: 100, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    OrderTimeline do
      OrderStep(title: :confirmed, at: today - 5.days + 10.hours)
      OrderStep(title: :shipped, at: today - 4.days + 16.hours + 20.minutes)
      OrderStep(title: :out_for_delivery, at: today - 1.day + 8.hours + 45.minutes)
      OrderStep(title: :delivered, at: today - 1.day + 13.hours + 2.minutes)
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Custom steps
examples.notes: Step titles take any string; a timeline works without the progress bar.
examples.code:
phlex do
  OrderTracker(number: "A-2291", items: 5, status: :delayed, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    OrderTimeline do
      OrderStep(title: "Customs cleared", at: Time.current - 3.hours)
      OrderStep(title: "Held at border - weather", at: Time.current - 20.minutes, state: :current)
      OrderStep(title: "Next attempt", at: Time.current + 1.day, state: :upcoming)
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says: the timeline line and markers sit on the right.
examples.code:

phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      OrderTracker(number: "10482", items: 2, total: 148, status: :in_transit, progress: 75, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
        OrderTimeline do
          OrderStep(title: :confirmed, at: today - 2.days + 9.hours + 41.minutes)
          OrderStep(title: :out_for_delivery, at: today + 11.hours + 5.minutes, state: :current)
          OrderStep(title: :delivered, at: today + 14.hours + 15.minutes, state: :upcoming)
        end
        OrderCourier(name: "Marcus", avatar: "/avatars/02.png", stops: 3, href: "#map")
      end
    end
  end
end
